work.title: Move shared application primitives out of WorkService
work.description: Move cross-cutting primitives such as Clock and systemClock to a neutral application module (src/application/clock.ts). Only primitives already shared by multiple services move; no generic utilities module is introduced.
acceptance: SpecService and WorkGraphService no longer import Clock from WorkService
Shared primitives have no dependency on a specific use case
Existing clock injection tests continue to work
